items.question: Is the software easy to use?
items.answer: Yes. The interface is designed for salon staff, with familiar terms and a simple billing flow.

items.question: Does it support multiple branches?
items.answer: Yes. You can manage several salon branches from one account.

items.question: Is training provided?
items.answer: Yes. Our team guides your staff through the setup and daily use.

items.question: Can it run on mobile and tablet?
items.answer: Yes. The software works on desktop, tablet and mobile devices.

items.question: Do you provide customer support?
items.answer: Yes. Dedicated support is available after setup.

items.question: Can I customize features for my salon?
items.answer: Yes. Features and setup are confirmed with you based on your salon needs.

items.question: How can I get a demo of the POS software?
items.answer: Send us a message using the form, or call us. We will confirm a time for a walkthrough that suits your salon.

items.question: Do you offer training for salon staff?
items.answer: Yes. Our team guides your staff through setup and daily use.

items.question: Do you provide support after purchase?
items.answer: Yes. Dedicated support is available after setup.

items.question: How can I order products?
items.answer: Products are ordered through the Glam Company store. Our team can also help you choose the right products.
